overlaps.definition_quote: a type 2 system corresponds to reciprocal sign epistasis
overlaps.definition_divergence: For L=2 the formula gives one type-2 square and no type-1 square. GraphFLA reports proportions across complete two-locus squares; with one square, the type-2 share is the reciprocal-sign proportion.

overlaps.paper_title: Designing Antibiotic Cycling Strategies by Determining and Understanding Local Adaptive Landscapes
overlaps.quote: probability for fixation at TEM 85 was 75%, and for ceftazidime 12.5%
overlaps.definition_quote: assumes that available beneficial mutations are equally likely to occur and go to fixation
overlaps.definition_divergence: These are population fixation probabilities under an equal-beneficial-mutation transition assumption, not a graph-level fraction of configurations or paths. The user excluded global_optima_accessibility from literature validation.
overlaps.reason: The printed values are stochastic fixation probabilities under a specified transition rule; no GraphFLA accessibility calculation was requested or made.

blockers.what: TEM-85 quantitative genotype-fitness inputs for cefotaxime and ceftazidime
blockers.why: The acquired source set and existing local GraphFLA files did not provide a tabular TEM-85 fitness input. The local Mira2015_TEM files are from a later TEM-50 growth-rate analysis. The Goulart peak targets also depend on ANOVA-based edge/equivalence calls.
blockers.needed_for: A separate comparison of the printed TEM-85 peak counts using a method that matches the paper's significance-based fitness graph.

verdict_reason: Crona et al.'s printed two-locus Example 1 target was reproduced exactly for n_lo and reciprocal-sign classification. The linked TEM-85 article prints two further peak counts and fixation probabilities, but its significance-based graph definitions are incompatible with a direct raw-ranking n_lo run; those limits are recorded.
